en: Black-and-white postcard showing a striking modernist concrete church building in a snowy landscape. The church has a tall, open-frame pyramidal tower with a cross at the top and bells partway up. The lower part of the structure has large rectangular windows. In the foreground there is snow-covered ground, a road with a car, street lamps, and a smaller adjacent building. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.
